title: Armstrong Air Furnace Code 200: No Signal from Thermostat
meaning: The control board is not receiving a heat call from the thermostat.
commonCauses: Thermostat set to off or cool
diySteps: Confirm the thermostat is set to heat.
Check that the furnace door is secure.
whenToCallPro: If the thermostat is calling for heat but the code remains, wiring may need service.
snippetAnswer: Armstrong Air furnace code 200 means control board is not receiving a heat call from the thermostat. Often caused by thermostat set to off or cool. Usually safe to try basic checks yourself; professional repairs run $100–$350.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.
